ns2:course.label: French & Comparative Cinema I
ns2:course.description: The art, techniques, sociology, politics of French cinema in the context of French culture, world history, and general film development from 1895 to approximately 1950. Selected trends studied through films from several countries with stress on major French filmmakers including Lumiere, Melies, Gance, Clair, Vigo, Renoir, Carne, Cocteau, Prevert, Clouzot. Knowledge of French not required. Same as CWL 387, HUM 387, and MACS 382. Credit is not given for both FR 387 and FR 488. Prerequisite: One college-level Media or Media and Cinema Studies course or consent of instructor.
